transcript: I think the only thing that I really didn't see was a more open commerce, like low, small government, big on capitalism, big on artisans and small businesses being successful. and keep the government small, still have a little list of rules, like the main things, but then for the majority, let people have their freedom to make their own decisions and make their own money based on how they see best fit for them.
